Maya (People Ops): Quick flag: onboarding batch this morning used the wrong deduction code for 401(k) — it posted as `401K-R` (rollover) instead of `401K-PR` (pre-tax). A few new hires may have had post-tax taken. Can someone triage?
Luis (Payroll): Which batch/file was that?
Maya (People Ops): onboard-batch-2024-06-14 09:02. Looks like 6 employees.
Asha (Benefits): If it was treated post-tax, vendor reclassification + YTD refiling might be required. Also double-check contribution limits for any overages.
Luis (Payroll): Pulling the payroll export now.
HRISBot: Export ready: onboard_20240614.csv attached to ticket.
Maya (People Ops): Snippet from the export: `emp_id,amount,code
100321,150,401K-R
100322,200,401K-R` 
Nikhil (Finance): Rough dollar exposure?
Maya (People Ops): About $980 total across the 6 rows.
Nikhil (Finance): I'll set aside $1.2k reserve on the payroll ledger until cleared.
Luis (Payroll): Submitted urgent ticket PL-9032 to payroll vendor requesting reclassification to `401K-PR` and confirmation export before month close.
Asha (Benefits): Vendor responded: they can reclassify before cutoff but require a signed vendor correction form from Redwood for compliance.
Maya (People Ops): I can sign the form today. I'll also draft a short employee note explaining the correction and that their net pay may adjust after reprocessing.
Luis (Payroll): Marked high priority. I'll update here when vendor posts the confirmation file and GL updates.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks — please escalate if we miss the cutoff so we can coordinate manual adjustments and tax remediation. :thumbsup:
